intro: Your price in about 60 seconds. No payment now.

contact.whatsappHelp: We send your quote and resume link here.
contact.consent: Viewora can send me my quote and follow-ups on WhatsApp and email. I can stop them any time.
contact.consentNote: Without this tick we only show your price here, and won't message you.

tiers.premiumNote: Adds a video, a reel and photos

result.included: Every tour includes 48-72 hour delivery, a shareable link, 1 revision round and 12 months of hosting.
result.estimate: Estimate. Our team confirms the final price within a working day.
result.custom: We'll send your price on WhatsApp within a working day.
result.title: Your price, {name}
result.customTitle: Thanks, {name}. We'll price this for you
result.beforeTravel: Standard option so far, before travel
result.customRunning: Our team prices this one by hand
result.travelUnconfirmed: Travel to your area is confirmed with you on WhatsApp before booking.
result.sentTo: We've saved this quote. We'll also send it to {phone} on WhatsApp.
result.paymentLater: Online deposit payment is coming soon. For now, book on WhatsApp and we'll send an M-Pesa request.

phone.empty: Add your WhatsApp number so we can send your quote.
phone.too_short: That number looks a digit or two short. Kenyan numbers look like 0712 345 678.
phone.too_long: That number has too many digits. Kenyan numbers look like 0712 345 678.
phone.not_mobile: That looks like a landline. We need a WhatsApp number, starting 07 or 01.

errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save this step. Your answers are still here; check your connection and tap Next again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Your answers are saved on this phone and will send when you reconnect.
errors.firstName: Add your first name so we know who to ask for.
errors.email: That email doesn't look right. Check it, or leave it empty.
errors.text: Tell us a little about the place.
errors.where: Type your area, or tap Use my location.
errors.loadFailed: We couldn't load the form. Check your connection and try again, or WhatsApp us and we'll quote you there.
errors.expired: Your saved quote link has expired, so we've started a fresh one. It takes about a minute.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find that saved quote, so we've started a fresh one.
errors.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Type your area instead.
errors.noRates: Prices are being updated. Please try again shortly or WhatsApp us.

warnings.discount_capped: Discount capped at {cap}%. An admin can approve more with a reason.
warnings.override_not_allowed: Only an admin can go past the discount cap.
warnings.travel_far: Far job: travel is actual cost plus accommodation and KES {perDiem} a day.
warnings.location_unresolved: We couldn't place this location. Confirm travel before sending.
warnings.scenes_missing: No scene count yet. Ask the client how many rooms or areas.
warnings.plan_exceeds: {scenes} scenes is more than {plan} allows ({cap} per tour).

where.pin: Drop a pin on the map
where.type: Or type the area, e.g. Kilimani
where.located: Location added, accurate to about {metres} m.
where.noteHelp: Parking, access times, who to call on the day.

contactIntro: Who you are changes a few questions. We'll send your price and a link back to this form.

extras.title: Add anything else?
extras.intro: All optional. Tap to add, tap again to remove.

whatsappHelp: Hi Viewora, I'm on the quote form ({step}) and have a question.
whatsappBook: Hi Viewora, I'd like to book the {tier} option ({amount}) for {industry}. My quote link: {link}

voice.unsupported: Voice typing isn't available in this browser. Please type instead.

describe.label: Tell us about the place
describe.restaurants: For example: a restaurant with a rooftop terrace, about 80 seats.
describe.developers: For example: a 5-acre plot in Kitengela with beacons, or a show house.
describe.malls: For example: a two-floor mall in Thika with 40 shops.
describe.institutions: For example: a dental clinic on two floors, or a school with 12 classrooms.
describe.farms: For example: a dairy farm in Limuru with a milking parlour.
describe.other: A sentence is enough, for example "a church hall and its grounds".

otherNote: We'll price this by hand and send it on WhatsApp within a working day. A few details help us get it right.

view.title: Your quote, {name}
view.deposit: A {percent}% deposit books your shoot date. The balance is due when your tour is delivered.
view.expired: It held until {date}. Prices may have changed, so ask us for an updated quote.
view.replaced: We sent you a newer version on {date}. Open the latest link we sent you, or ask us for it on WhatsApp.
view.replacedNoDate: We sent you a newer version. Open the latest link we sent you, or ask us for it on WhatsApp.
view.closed: It is no longer available. If you still need a tour, we will gladly send you a new quote.
view.gone: Quote links work for a month after the price expires. Ask us for a new one on WhatsApp.
view.notFound: Check that you opened the whole link from your message. If it still doesn't work, ask us on WhatsApp.
view.loadFailed: We couldn't load your quote. Check your connection and try again.
view.accepted: You accepted this quote. We will be in touch about your shoot date.
